baselines.b3d: built (t, td, wind; WBGT has no bias7)

notes: Regime (a) serves the released model through the serving path, whose gate needs all nine inputs (t, td, wind, shortwave, direct radiation, pressure, grid latitude, longitude and elevation): a row missing any of them has no corrector forecast and is dropped for EVERY model of regime (a), so its models are scored on the same rows.

Regime (c) refits cold models whose features do not need pressure or radiation: it can score T, Td and wind on rows regime (a) drops, so the two regimes may score different row sets for those variables. Read each regime's numbers next to its own counts (counts.test_rows, and n_rows and n_no_forecast in each skill row).

a.description: known sites, new summer: the released model through the serving path

c.description: new cluster, new summer: six cold models, each refit without the held-out cluster
